value.rationale: Even derangements form a canonical restriction of a well-studied incidence concept class. At six symbols it has the same VC dimension as the unrestricted class but loses 1575 top faces and gains 360 lower-dimensional facets: these differences are invisible to dimension. A researcher studying parity-constrained matching complexes can use the exact simultaneous-label orbit decomposition and boundary ranks, particularly the two consecutive nonzero homology groups. This is a useful finite baseline and not a claim of an all-order homotopy type.
